d: Leaving behind her glamorous life in Hollywood, Evie Lee returns to her small hometown and her family's once-prosperous Christmas tree farm to attend her father's funeral. She must now take over management of the farm, much to the dismay of her younger brother.
Christmas Land has seen better days since Glinda's tragic passing and Jules is forced to make many complicated decisions.

From cooking to decorating, Carol sleeps and breathes Christmas, so it's no wonder the town refers to her as “Christmas Carol” but when a handsome man comes to town and challenges her traditional holiday views, Carol must learn how to compromise even if it means facing an unexpected romance.

When Holly proposes to Phil, he admits he needs closure with an ex. Heartbroken, she confides in sleigh driver Jake, who offers unexpected comfort. Is Phil her true love, or is Jake the Christmas miracle she's been waiting for?

Darcy Archer is a romantic, she dreams of being swept off her feet by the perfect man. Instead, she accidentally crashes into a handsome, sharply dressed stranger walking his dog. He is knocked unconscious and taken to hospital, leaving his puppy and a mysterious Christmas gift behind.
